@Test
public void testContentTypeInitParams() throws Exception {
    // Default is INIT_PARAM_VALUE_ALWAYS, hence null is the same:
    for (String overrideCT : new String[] { null, INIT_PARAM_VALUE_ALWAYS }) {
        assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
        DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE + "; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
        null, // <- init-params
        overrideCT, FOO_FTL, // <- request
        null);
        assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
        "text/css; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
        "text/css", // <- init-params
        overrideCT, FOO_FTL, // <- request
        null);
        assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
        DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE + "; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
        null, // <- init-params
        overrideCT, FOO_FTL, // <- request
        "application/json");
        assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
        "text/css; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
        "text/css", // <- init-params
        overrideCT, FOO_FTL, // <- request
        "application/json");
        assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
        "text/plain", // <- init-params
        null, // <- init-params
        overrideCT, CONTENT_TYPE_ATTR_FTL, // <- request
        "application/json");
        assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
        "text/plain; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
        null, // <- init-params
        overrideCT, OUTPUT_FORMAT_HEADER_FTL, // <- request
        "application/json");
    }
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE + "; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_WHEN_TEMPLATE_HAS_MIME_TYPE, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/css; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    "text/css", // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_WHEN_TEMPLATE_HAS_MIME_TYPE, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_WHEN_TEMPLATE_HAS_MIME_TYPE, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json", // <- init-params
    "text/css", // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_WHEN_TEMPLATE_HAS_MIME_TYPE, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/plain", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_WHEN_TEMPLATE_HAS_MIME_TYPE, CONTENT_TYPE_ATTR_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/plain; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_WHEN_TEMPLATE_HAS_MIME_TYPE, OUTPUT_FORMAT_HEADER_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE + "; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_NEVER, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/css; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    "text/css", // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_NEVER, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_NEVER, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json", // <- init-params
    "text/css", // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_NEVER, FOO_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_NEVER, CONTENT_TYPE_ATTR_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    INIT_PARAM_VALUE_NEVER, OUTPUT_FORMAT_HEADER_FTL, // <- request
    "application/json");
}

@Test
public void testStandardContentType() throws Exception {
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/html; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_HTML_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/xhtml+xml; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_XHTML_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/xml; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_XML_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/javascript; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_JAVA_SCRIPT_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/json; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_JSON_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/css; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_CSS_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "text/plain; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_PLAIN_TEXT_FTL, // <- request
    null);
    assertResponseContentTypeEquals(// <- expected
    "application/rtf; charset=UTF-8", // <- init-params
    null, // <- init-params
    null, STD_OUTPUT_FORMAT_RTF_FTL, // <- request
    null);
}
